scope: Spatial association diagnostic with manual landmarks; no learned detection, no learned cap identification, no automatic body-instance model.

methods.point_nearest: Each nose chooses minimum Euclidean distance cap among all 11 caps; cap reuse allowed.
methods.line_nearest: Line through nose perpendicular to manually specified screen direction; choose cap with minimum absolute distance to that line; cap reuse allowed.
methods.point_one_to_one: Globally minimum sum of Euclidean distances; each cap can be used once; all 11 caps remain candidates, only visible annotated noses are queries.

body_reference: Human-readable same-horse links annotated by assistant after inspecting head/neck/body/rider. Reference only, not an automated method and must not be scored as 100% accuracy.
direction_source: Manual rough view axis; not inferred motion, calibrated track coordinates, or official rank.
timing_includes: coordinate distance and matching only, excludes detection, annotation, image decode, I/O and cap recognition

sensitivity.meaning: Exploratory coordinate jitter stability, not calibrated detector error or statistical confidence interval.
